item.title: Australia enforces world-first social media ban for under-16s
item.description: Australia has introduced a landmark ban preventing children under 16 from holding accounts on major social media platforms, in what is being described as a world-first attempt to curb online harms among young people.

item.title: Goa nightclub fire: co-owner detained as authorities raze encroachment at sister property
item.description: Goa Police on Tuesday detained Ajay Gupta, one of the owners of the Birch by Romeo Lane nightclub, as the administration hurried to display action after a blaze at the venue killed 25 people over the weekend.

item.title: Mumbai Police form SIT to investigate minister’s aide in wife’s suicide case
item.description: Mumbai Police have constituted a Special Investigation Team (SIT) to examine allegations of abetment of suicide against Anant Garje, personal assistant to Maharashtra minister Pankaja Munde, officials said on Tuesday.

item.title: Delhi’s air quality improves, AQI drops to 267
item.description: Delhi recorded an improvement in air quality on Wednesday, with the overall Air Quality Index (AQI) reaching 267 at 9 am, according to data from the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).

item.title: Sensex and Nifty recover after two-day slump
item.description: Markets rebound after two days of sharp losses. Sensex jumps 259 pts to 84,925.59, Nifty up 64.65 pts at 25,904.30 in early trade as investors buy at lower levels.

item.title: Detained nightclub partner says he ‘knows nothing’ about Goa fire
item.description: Ajay Gupta, a business associate of Saurabh Luthra and one of the owners of the Birch by Romeo Lane nightclub in Goa, gave his first reaction on Wednesday after being detained by Delhi Police.

item.title: Trump’s latest tally: eight wars stopped in 10 months, cites India-Pakistan tensions
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Tuesday again claimed he ended the India-Pakistan conflict, a statement he has now repeated nearly 70 times.

item.title: 4 killed, 27 hurt in bus-truck collision on Jaipur-Bikaner national highway
item.description: Four people were killed and 27 others injured after a bus collided head-on with a truck on Jaipur-Bikaner National Highway in the Sikar district of Rajasthan on Tuesday (9 December) night

item.title: Canada’s US ambassador Kirsten Hillman to step down ahead of trade agreement review
item.description: Canada’s ambassador to the US, Kirsten Hillman, will step down next year after six years in Washington, ahead of the planned review of the USMCA trade pact.

item.title: Kim Jong Un’s inner circle readies for once-in-five-years party meet
item.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has convened senior officials to prepare for the ruling party’s first full congress in five years, state media said on Wednesday, as the United States and South Korea continue to push for renewed dialogue with Pyongyang.
